description: The AI has a single strength (formerly 'Competitive') — there is no difficulty to choose. Boots the real main menu and asserts no difficulty picker/label exists anywhere in it, that the default P2=AI seat still shows its AI-only plan row, and that toggling P1 Human->AI->Human shows/hides P1's AI-only row (the type-change signal wiring that used to live in the difficulty-dropdown builder). Presses Start and asserts the game_config carries no *_difficulty keys and AIPlayer has P2 as AI with no per-seat difficulty API.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
return "p2_type=%d p2_plan_visible=%s" % [m.player2_type_dropdown.selected, str(m.player2_plan_container.visible)]

var m = tree.current_scene
m.player1_type_dropdown.select(1)
m.player1_type_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", 1)
return "p1_plan_visible=%s" % str(m.player1_plan_container.visible)

var m = tree.current_scene
m.player1_type_dropdown.select(0)
m.player1_type_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", 0)
return "p1_plan_visible=%s" % str(m.player1_plan_container.visible)
